name: qwen3next_gdn_packed_decode_hv4_d128
description: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B packed Gated-Delta-Net decode: one token per sequence, QKV unpacked from the fused projection, gating and the recurrent update fused into a single Triton kernel, and the SSM state slot updated in place. This is the decode counterpart to gdn_prefill and the highest-traffic linear-attention kernel in the capture (266,688 recorded calls). Shapes and state slots come from Qwen3-Next served with its own SGLang cookbook command on 8x B300 (GSM8K 1.000 on the capture run).

num_seqs.description: Decode batch: one token per sequence.

num_slots.description: State slots the server allocated in the SSM pool.

num_qk_heads.description: Query/key heads (H). Recovered from the packed width exactly as the kernel recovers it: HV / H = 2.

qkv_dim.description: Packed projection width: H*K + H*K + HV*V.

constraints: cache_indices holds num_seqs *distinct* slots below num_slots - two sequences sharing a slot is a read-modify-write race, not a slower kernel
ssm_states is updated in place: the slots named by cache_indices are both input and output
q and k are L2-normalised inside the kernel (use_qk_l2norm_in_kernel=True)

mixed_qkv.description: Fused QKV projection output after the causal conv1d. Unpacks as q[H,K], k[H,K], v[HV,V].

a.description: Decay input. g = exp(-exp(A_log) * softplus(a + dt_bias)).

ssm_states.description: Full state pool in k-last layout, updated in place. Only the slots this batch owns are materialised: the benchmark allocates the recorded geometry and writes the captured state at its captured slots, so strides and addressing are real and untouched slots are never read.

num_v_heads.description: Value-head count, passed to the kernel (same value as the axis).

head_v_dim.description: Value dimension, passed to the kernel (same value as the axis).

out.description: Decode output, returned (a transposed view of the kernel's [B,1,HV,V] buffer).

ssm_states.description: The same pool, with this batch's slots advanced by one step. Comparing only `out` would miss a candidate that drifts the state underneath a correct-looking output.
